method.measurement_kind: SQL cardinality measurements only; no compiler, builds, tests, or GPU runs
method.prefix_cost: Sum of surviving root and joined prefix COUNT(*) positions, with every available local guard applied. Base scans and index-build rows are reported separately, not hidden in prefix counts.
method.line_identity_distinct_method: Per order, BIT_OR(1::UBIGINT << l_linenumber), then sum BIT_COUNT. Measured linenumber bounds are 1..7, with no nulls; hence exact distinct (orderkey,linenumber), not an estimate.

measurements.name: lineitem_keys_and_fk_fanout
measurements.sql:
WITH per_order AS (
 SELECT l_orderkey, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(l_linenumber) AS min_line, MAX(l_linenumber) AS max_line,
        BIT_OR(1::UBIGINT << CAST(l_linenumber AS INTEGER)) AS line_bitmap,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l_linenumber IS NULL) AS null_line_numbers
 FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_order_keys, SUM(n)::BIGINT AS lineitem_rows,
 SUM(BIT_COUNT(line_bitmap))::BIGINT AS distinct_order_line_keys,
 MIN(min_line) AS min_line_number, MAX(max_line) AS max_line_number,

provenance.measurement_kind: Exact DuckDB cardinality and distinct-count SQL, not build/test/GPU execution
provenance.oracle_sql_note: Authored SQL is recorded for semantics. Counts were obtained by the exact SQL in measurements, not by a workload test run.

methodology.prefix_cost: Sum COUNT(*) after root local selection and after each subsequent positive relation with then-bound guards. Anti/exists membership probes do not expand positions; report their survival and terminal counts separately. Also report pre-anti expanded visit counts for h16. Full base scans and reusable index/set construction are not in this cardinality objective.
methodology.anti_roots: A relation inside NOT EXISTS/negation cannot seed the positive output domain. BadSupplier and Orders in h22 are build/probe domains, not valid positive roots.
methodology.fanout_threshold: Strict >4, not >=4. Report both mean and maximum/tail. Split before an actual expanding edge with mean >4 if a raw unfiltered index is used; membership lookup is nonexpanding even when underlying duplicate-key fanout exceeds 4.
methodology.numeric_values: All counts are measured SQL integers. Ratios and cost sums are arithmetic on those counts. Recommendations are inference from measured cardinality, not GPU performance measurements.
methodology.measurement_reference: Every measurement identifier resolves to exact SQL and numeric rows for both scales in measurements.

method.metric: Sum of post-local-selection COUNT(*) over connected prefixes, root included. Minimum among measured sensible candidates. Prefix output positions are not actual scanned adjacency entries.
method.h07_block: ns and nc form two-row exact opposite-country relation; IN restrictions are implied, not a replacement for the OR.
method.limitations: An initial exhaustive SF1 pass completed, but a monolithic SF10 statistics call timed out and destroyed in-memory results. This persisted dataset remeasures a smaller sensible candidate set; no numbers inferred.
method.h07_timeout_resolution: The OR-connected branch predicate led to long-running optimizer execution in initial SF10 prefix counting. Persisted H07 paired prefixes use an exact UNION ALL of disjoint France/Germany and Germany/France branches. DISTINCT is applied only at final output, not within COUNT-prefix witness measurements.
method.fanout_segmentation: Recommend a segmentation boundary before each chosen keyed expansion whose measured maximum adjacency fanout exceeds four. Both pre-next-local-predicate and post-next-local-predicate distributions are recorded. A post-filter mean under four does not prove per-key fanout <=4.
